cards.front: Recall a key point about Data Structures and Algorithms
cards.back: Arrays: contiguous, O(1) access; Lists: dynamic, O(1) append amortised; Stacks: LIFO, push/pop; Queues: FIFO, enqueue/dequeue

cards.front: Recall a key point about Data Structures and Algorithms
cards.back: Linked lists: singly/doubly, O(1) insert/delete at known position, O(n) access

cards.front: Recall a key point about Data Structures and Algorithms
cards.back: Trees: binary, BST (left<root<right), AVL/Red-Black (balanced); traversals: pre/in/post-order, level-order

cards.front: Recall a key point about Data Structures and Algorithms
cards.back: Graphs: adjacency matrix/list; directed/undirected, weighted/unweighted; BFS/DFS

cards.front: Recall a key point about Data Structures and Algorithms
cards.back: Hash tables: O(1) average, collisions (chaining, open addressing), load factor

cards.front: Recall a key point about Data Structures and Algorithms
cards.back: Big-O: O(1) < O(log n) < O(n) < O(n log n) < O(n^2) < O(2ⁿ); best/average/worst case

cards.front: Recall a key point about Data Structures and Algorithms
cards.back: Search: linear O(n), binary O(log n) sorted, hash O(1); Sort: bubble/insertion O(n^2), merge/quick/heap O(n log n)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Data Structures and Algorithms
cards.back: Recursion: base case, recursive case; Tree traversals; Graph: Dijkstra (shortest path), Prim/Kruskal (MST), Topological sort (DAG)
